caption:
You know your best customers by name.
Your follow-up system doesn't.

Run this two-question gate on every job you closed last quarter:
1. Did they pay full price without negotiating?
2. Would they take your call again without hesitating?

Yes to both: Tier A. Personal referral ask, priority rebooking, a direct review request from you.

Yes to one: Tier B. Automated review request, included in your seasonal win-back send, no referral push yet.

No to both: Tier C. Win-back automation only. Fix the complaint before you ask for anything.

Most shops run the same cadence for all three. That's revenue left on the table.

DM TRIAL
#ServiceBusiness #CRM #CustomerRetention #SmallBusinessGrowth #HomeServiceMarketing
rationale: Carousels still lead 2026 saves/depth for B2B authority content, and this ships a genuinely unclaimed post-sale customer-tiering framework (satisfaction x referral potential) distinct from every prior lead-stage, ladder, decay-curve, and reactivation-bucket model already shipped.
